data.name: Najdah
data.gender_notes: Najdah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of a desert in Arabia, symbolizing vastness and emptiness. The name Najdah carries the meaning “Desert” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najdah usually hope their child will grow to embody desert and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Najdah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desert.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najdah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نجدة
in_arabic.meaning: النجدة تعني الإنقاذ والنجاة من الخطر أو الشدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نجدّة مشتق من الجذر النجدي، ويعني الإنقاذ والنجاة من الخطر أو الشدة. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا'. يرمز الاسم إلى الشجاعة والإقدام في مواجهة التحديات، ويحمل دلالات إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نجدہ
in_urdu.meaning: نجدہ کا مطلب ہے کسی کو خطرے یا مشکل سے بچانا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نجدہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، خاص طور پر 'نجد' سے جو کہ 'خطرے سے بچانا' یا 'سخت محنت کرنا' کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم کردار ہے، جو بہادری، قوتِ ارادہ اور تعاون کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایات میں، نجدہ کو اکثر بہادری اور عزم کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नजदाह
in_hindi.meaning: नजदाह का अर्थ है किसी को खतरे या कठिनाई से बचाना
in_hindi.long_meaning: नजदाह नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल से हुई है, विशेष रूप से 'नजद' से जो 'किसी को खतरे से बचाना' या 'कठिन परिश्रम करना' के अर्थ रखता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका है, जो बहादुरी, संकल्प और सहयोग का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, नजदाह को अक्सर बहादुरी और दृढ़ संकल्प का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نجدہ
in_pashto.meaning: نجدہ د دې معنی دی چی کوم څوک د خطر یا سختی څخه ژغورل
in_pashto.long_meaning: نجدہ نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول 'نجد' څخه چې 'د خطر څخه ژغورل' یا 'سخت کار کول' معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون قومونو کې، نجدہ د زړورتیا، عزم او همکارۍ د نښه په توګه لیدل کیږي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د خپلو ټولنو په دفاع کې مهم رول لوبوي.

in_english.name: Najdah
in_english.meaning: Najdah means rescuing or saving from danger or difficulty
in_english.long_meaning: Najdah is derived from the Arabic root 'najd', which means 'to rescue' or 'to save from danger'. This name appears in various forms throughout Islamic history, symbolizing bravery, determination, and salvation. In Islamic tradition, Najdah represents the act of saving or being saved, reflecting positive attributes such as heroism and selflessness. The name is associated with strength, courage, and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Najdah holds significant cultural importance in Saudi Arabia, as it refers to the central Arabian Peninsula, where the cities of Riyadh and Mecca are located. Najd is an oulent, bare desert iconic of the Arabian landscape. This region has been a pivotal center for commerce, pilgrimage, and culture throughout history. The name Najdah highlights the vastness and emptiness, invoking thoughts of the epic journeys and lifestyles of the desert nomads who have made their homes in this rugged landscape.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Najd represents a space of spiritual purity and focus. The Arabic term, Najjah, translates to salvation or deliverance. Therefore, in a metaphorical sense, Najdah can symbolize a spiritual pilgrimage, a journey towards enlightenment and self-purification. It serves as a reminder of the importance of being present and detached, with a singular focus on connecting with Allah (God) amid the barren and seemingly insignificant desert landscape. The name Najdah, thus, speaks to the inner journey toward spiritual growth and fulfillment.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Najdah bint Wahb was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Najdah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: She is mentioned in various Hadiths and Sira literature.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Najdah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
